items.source: Subclasses are passed the message to write to the log in the beforeRequest and afterRequest methods. By default, only the URI of the request is logged. However, setting the includeQueryString property to true will cause the query string of the request to be included also; this can be further extended through includeClientInfo and includeHeaders. The payload (body content) of the request can be logged via the includePayload flag: Note that this will only log the part of the payload which has actually been read, not necessarily the entire body of the request.
items.translation: 子类在 beforeRequest 和 afterRequest 方法中接收到要写入日志的消息。默认情况下，仅记录请求的 URI。但是，将 includeQueryString 属性设置为 true 会导致同时包含请求的查询字符串；这可以通过 includeClientInfo 和 includeHeaders 进一步扩展。请求的有效负载（主体内容）可以通过 includePayload 标志进行记录：请注意，这将仅记录实际读取的部分有效负载，而不一定是请求的整个主体。

items.source: Prefixes and suffixes for the before and after messages can be configured using the beforeMessagePrefix, afterMessagePrefix, beforeMessageSuffix and afterMessageSuffix properties.
items.translation: `beforeMessagePrefix`、`afterMessagePrefix`、`beforeMessageSuffix` 和 `afterMessageSuffix` 属性可用于配置 before 和 after 消息的前缀和后缀。
如果 `includeQueryString` 为 `true`，则日志消息的内部部分将采用 `request_uri?query_string` 的形式；否则，消息将简单地采用 `request_uri` 的形式。

items.source: Subclasses should override the beforeRequest(HttpServletRequest, String) and afterRequest(HttpServletRequest, String) methods to perform the actual logging around the request.
items.translation: 子类应重写 `beforeRequest(HttpServletRequest, String)` 和 `afterRequest(HttpServletRequest, String)` 方法，以在请求周围执行实际的日志记录。

items.source: Should be configured using an <init-param> for parameter name "includeQueryString" in the filter definition in web.xml.
items.translation: 应使用 `<init-param>` 在 `web.xml` 中的过滤器定义里配置参数名称为 "includeQueryString"。

items.source: Should be configured using an <init-param> for parameter name "includeClientInfo" in the filter definition in web.xml.
items.translation: 应使用 `<init-param>` 在 `web.xml` 中的过滤器定义里配置参数名称为 "includeClientInfo" 的参数。

items.source: Should be configured using an <init-param> for parameter name "includeHeaders" in the filter definition in web.xml.

items.source: Should be configured using an <init-param> for parameter name "includePayload" in the filter definition in web.xml.
items.translation: 应使用 `<init-param>` 在 `web.xml` 中的过滤器定义里配置参数名称为 "includePayload"。

items.source: The predicate will be applied once per query parameter name. Thus, if there are multiple values for the same query parameter name, the logged query string will contain fewer name=value mappings than the one returned by HttpServletRequest.getQueryString().
items.translation: 谓词将针对每个查询参数名称应用一次。因此，如果同一查询参数名称有多个值，记录的查询字符串中将包含的 `name=value` 映射少于 HttpServletRequest.getQueryString() 返回的映射。

items.source: The default implementation always returns true. Subclasses may override this with a log level check.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回true。子类可以使用日志级别检查来覆盖此行为。
